svg.aria-label: S14 The retire window, 330 groups, the rename retire queue and the counters
svg.text: S14 The retire window, 330 groups, the rename retire queue and the counters

The groups form a ring, drawn as a column that wraps, with the first and last five as slots. The rename retire queue sits beside it, then the commit pointer, the rates, the branch counter and the free-list return.
limits that are their own window
Empty slots mean nothing else is in flight.
~ A memory op starts a group and a branch ends one.
a flush frees the new one, from the tail
Each micro-op that changes the map takes one entry.
Rename writes it and retire frees it.
4 issuing slots a group give about 1000
The window by kind of op
The player fills a group slot per micro-op.
It fills a queue entry per rename.
